findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler does not implement the new abstract build_occurrence_and_event_data
findings.description: The class body is now `pass`, but `StatefulDetectorHandler` gains `@abc.abstractmethod build_occurrence_and_event_data` in processors/detector.py. Since `DetectorHandler` derives from `abc.ABC`, instantiating `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` will raise `TypeError`. This is latent if the class is never instantiated, but any path that builds it through `detector_handler` will fail.

findings.title: test_results_on_change builds expected occurrence with value 6 while evaluating value 100
findings.description: The handler is evaluated with `{"val1": 100}`, but the expected occurrence is built via `build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, "val1", 6, ...)`. The mock currently ignores `value`, so the test passes, but the fixture does not match the input and would hide a regression if the value were used.

findings.title: test_dedupe builds expected occurrence with value 6 while evaluating value 8
findings.description: The first evaluate call uses `{"val1": 8}`, but the expected occurrence is built with `6`. Same problem as above: the fixture is inconsistent with the input.

findings.title: TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe builds occurrence for "val1" but expects group_key "group_key"
findings.description: The occurrence is built with `build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, "val1", 6, ...)`, while `expected_result` is constructed with `"group_key"`. The occurrence fingerprint is derived from the group key, so the fixture mixes two different group keys. The `evaluate_group_key_value` call is cut off in the diff, so I could not confirm the input key it uses.

findings.title: New annotations reference names whose imports are not visible in the diff
findings.description: `DetectorGroupKey` (in `process_detectors`, `evaluate`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`) and `Any` (in `build_occurrence_and_event_data`) are used in the new signatures. The diff only adds the `PriorityLevel` import, and I could not confirm from the hunks that `DetectorGroupKey` and `Any` are already imported. Please verify, since a missing import would fail type checking.
